qs.q: The first step in rational prescribing is:
qs.e: The WHO six-step approach starts with: 1) Define the patient's problem, 2) Specify therapeutic objective, 3) Select treatment strategy, 4) Select appropriate drug, 5) Verify suitability, 6) Give information/instructions.
